Gamboa, 25 kilometers from Panama City, now seems frozen in time: it is the best preserved of all the towns of the old Panama Canal Company. No glass towers and shopping malls, nor have beautified the terse houses of the 30's and 40's. Gamboa remains an open place without fences, claims or commercialism.

Did You Know?
The Gamboa Rainforest Reserve design is inspired by the former Hotel Tivoli, whose construction began in 1905 and opened to the public in 1907. It was located at the foot of ancon hill and had many famous guests during its existence, like President Theodore Roosevelt in December of 1906 right before its opening.
Learn About the Reserve
The Soberanía National Park
A 55,000-acre unique tropical ecosystem. It has been protected for almost a century as part of the Panama Canal basin, with large tracts of lowland tropical rainforest.

Resorts in Panama | Gamboa Rainforest Reserve | Gamboa, Panama
Skip to navigation

Experience it All
Our 166 rustic-elegant rooms and suites feature private balconies and hammocks. A landscaped pool and waterfall is surrounded by comfortable chaise lounges. Exhilarating eco-tours and adventures include aerial tram, night safaris and more.
Chagres River
From the waters of the Chagres River, pre-Columbian Hispanic and indigenous history flourishes; all the gold that crossed by its waters and Camino de Cruzes; the history of the Isthmus since its inception, the time of the construction of the Canal and the villages on its shores that today are submerged by the flood of Gatun Lake like Gorgona, New Emperor, Cuipo, and many more.
From the waters of the Chagres River, pre-Columbian Hispanic and indigenous history flourishes; all the gold that crossed by its waters and Camino de Cruzes; the history of the Isthmus since its inception, the time of the construction of the Canal and the villages on its shores that today are submerged by the flood of Gatun Lake like Gorgona, New Emperor, Cuipo, and many more.
What time are check-in and check-out?
Check-in is at 3:00 p.m. and checkout is at noon.
Does the reserve offer handicap-accessible rooms?
Yes, we do have specially equipped rooms for persons with disabilities. Additionally, our entire hotel is designed to be wheelchair accessible, and the Aerial Tram is also wheelchair accessible.
The Lobby
The lobby is a three-level atrium with large windows and in which we find lianas, shrubs and an artificial waterfall that give an ecological tonic to the property.
